title: Eilenberg-MacLane spaces in A-homotopy theory
summary: In this paper we study a discrete homotopy theory for undirected graphs. More precisely, we consider $A$-homotopy groups, first defined in the work of Barcelo, Kramer, Laubenbacher and Weaver. For every degree $n$ and every group $G$ (Abelian if $n\geq 2$), we construct a graph whose $n$-th $A$-homotopy group is isomorphic to $G$ and whose other $A$-homotopy groups all vanish.
